description: End-to-end product design orchestrator for opinionated, human-crafted UI — not generic AI output. Covers experience thesis, design system definition, interaction modeling, component architecture, screen design, and mandatory anti-slop audit. Use when the deliverable is a DESIGN SPEC or a design-led BUILD — meaning decisions about experience, visual language, and system architecture must be made before or alongside code. Supports three modes: new product design, redesign/improve existing UI, and standalone design audit. Triggers on: experience thesis, design system for my app, UI that doesn't suck, anti-slop, design audit, improve this UI, redesign this, make this feel authored, visual direction, cinematic design, what should this look like, or any request where design thinking must precede or drive implementation. Do NOT use for pure code builds where design is already decided — use executing-branded-frontends instead. Do NOT use for brief generation — use managing-design-briefs instead.
